plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-14 from the official University of Washington Bothell degree-map PDF 'B-Conservation-and-Restoration-Science-Degree-Map-2022.pdf' (printed footer 'Last updated: 9/22/2022'), hosted on uwb.edu. Filed under catalog_year 2022-2023: this is an ARCHIVED map, not the current catalog. The current UW Bothell catalog is 2026-2027, and the degree maps the site currently links to are UW NetID SharePoint Word documents and MyPlan, both login-walled; no login was attempted, so the public 2022 PDF is the newest publicly verifiable official term-by-term map for this program. The map calls itself 'a suggested schedule of courses based on degree requirements' and 'not a substitute for academic advising' (printed on the map). UW Bothell is a quarter-system school; the 12 blocks below are the map's 12 quarters (Autumn/Winter/Spring, Years 1-4) in printed order. The map prints no per-term totals and no degree total. No parenthetical credit number is printed anywhere on this map (the printed '(F)' fieldwork marker and '(min 2.0)' / '(min 2.5)' grade notes are not credit numbers), so under the printed rule every slot is 5 credits, each quarter sums to 15 and the plan to 180, the standard UW Bothell bachelor's total. Markers printed on the map are disclosed, not recorded as prerequisites (the map prints no course-to-course prerequisite chain, so no prereqs are recorded): the solid diamond means 'Prerequisite: Must be completed prior to applying for a major'; the checkmark means 'Milestones: Courses and special requirements necessary to timely progress through and complete a major'; the star means 'See list of choices' — those lists are not printed on the map, so star-marked slots list no options; the four-point marker means 'May be fulfilled with Discovery Core'; '(F)' means '10 credits of fieldwork required'. The map prints no course titles for BMATH 122, BMATH 123, BIS 215 or BIS 342; they are recorded as 'no title printed on the degree map' rather than sourced elsewhere. Printed choice cells are recorded as choice slots with exactly the printed options: 'BIS 243 / BIS 246' (Year 2 Winter), 'BES 312 or BIS 390' (Year 3 Autumn), 'BES 301 or BST 301' (Year 3 Winter), 'BIS 344 or BIS 442 or BES 440' (Year 3 Spring), and 'Geospatial, Mathematical & Earth Science or Natural History and Ecological Science (F)' (Year 4 Autumn). The combined 'B CHEM 143/144 General Chemistry I & Lab' cell is folded into one entry under the lecture code. 'Earth Systems Science Course' (Year 1 Spring), 'Approved CRS Elective' (twice), 'Approved Capstone Research' (twice) and the generic category slots are transcribed with their printed wording as choice slots with unique synthetic codes.
